build-2.title: Tools behind MCP. A model is optional.

columns.heading: MCP
items: Internal MCP server: 18 tools; money tools policy-gated
Treasurer agent: at most 25 tool calls per task, per-task allowlists
No agent task can execute remedies
Public read-only MCP: 4 tools, demo circles only, PII masked

columns.heading: Three modes, always labelled
items: Free model by default (Gemini or Groq; Anthropic optional)
AI replay: recorded model turns replayed, no quota spent
Rules mode: deterministic fallback, same tools, no model

build-2.footnote: The recorded live sandbox run used rules mode (no model call).
